text.text_excerpt: I think this is the first time I've stayed at a Staybridge Suites, but it won't be the last. I was trying to use up some of my IHG points while in New Orleans and booked this place because the Holiday Inn was booked. This place is like the Embassy Suites, it has a full kitchen, spacious rooms, and a great breakfast. Like Embassy Suites they also have complimentary evening snacks and cocktails which were awesome. The Cajun Pork Hotdogs were amazing! I will be back very very soon Staybridge Suites. I enjoyed myself immensely and appreciate the wonderful service. By the way they also have washers and dryers if you need those? We didn't, but thought I'd tell ya, because it would have been con...

I was extremely pleased with Staybridge Suites. This is a really nice hotel with a convenient location right outside the French Quarter so that everything is within walking distance, but you are not surrounded by the rowdy night life. The room was very spacious and we fit 4 people into one room. When we walked in, I ooed and aahed at our lovely little kitchen and big living room. The kitchen was stocked with dishes and utensils and even a small container of dish soap. The bedroom had two queen beds and there was a tv both inside the bedroom and outside in the living room. And there was also FREE wifi! And there was also two packets of complimentary coffee and popcorn. I felt like a little...

This is a great place to stay while visiting this fun city. It's conveniently located midway between the convention center and the French Quarter, the staff were very kind, the rooms were very clean, and the price was way better than the surrounding hotels. The rooms are also very, very quiet and I couldn't hear anything from outside, even though I was on the 2nd floor. I would definitely stay here again!
